title: Research Data Analyst
description: An academic medical center is hiring a Research Data Analyst to support clinical research studies. You will manage EHR-derived datasets, run descriptive and inferential analyses in R and SAS, and prepare data for IRB submissions. Prior work with clinical trial data and epidemiology is strongly preferred.
